reason: My booking system already has an online booking button, so I can't see what this adds on top of it. I've tried a website chat before and it gave wrong answers or nobody used it, so I'm not keen to pay for another one.
objection: Whether it will give my patients wrong answers about prices or availability, and whether anyone will actually use the chat once it's on the site.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it books straight into my calendar and hands over to my staff when unsure, shown on a free trial with real visitors using it.
